name: The Hornet Queen
a2: VIOLATION: windingUp() only recognises 'aim' and 'slamHang' for t==='queen' (main.js:18448). Her sweep and volley attacks wind up through 'sweepStart' and 'volleyUp' first (main.js:8420-8421, 8427, 8455) which do NOT end in 'Tell' and are not named in the queen clause, so the enemy-highlight + tell-SFX (used at main.js:21289, 18564) never fires for two of her four attacks.
window: mostly hittable at normal damage; 2x bonus while 'winded' (dmg*=2, main.js hurtEnemy0 ~5303); no-hit deflect during 'slamRest'/'buck' recovery
a11why: 'winded' (her bonus window) is entered automatically at the end of every dive (queenWinded() call, main.js:8452) whether or not the dive connected — it is her own recovery beat, not something the player causes.
a10: At half HP ('ENRAGED', hurtEnemy0 ~5536) her dive/hover/sweep speeds and volley count all increase and her windups shorten — the fight gets faster across the board but nothing new appears.
bugs: A2: sweep and volley windups (sweepStart/volleyUp) have no visual/audio tell — see a2 above.

name: The Bullfrog King
a2: ok (crouch, inhaleTell, tongueTell all covered by the explicit frog clause in windingUp(), main.js:18448)
window: hittable at normal damage in any mode; 2x bonus in 'croak' and 'dazed' (main.js hurtEnemy0 ~5303)
a11why: 'dazed' is entered automatically whenever a leap lands off-target (main.js:8538-8540) and 'croak' is one of his own randomly-picked moves (main.js:8512, 8519) — both arrive on his own rotation, not from a specific player action (parry/lure/etc).
a10: Phase 2 (2/3 HP) adds pond-rise croaks and heavier attack odds; phase 3 (1/3 HP, frogDrain()) permanently drains the pond into a pit — landing a leap now sticks him in the mud ('mired') instead of just dazing him, changing where he is safe to hit.
bugs: A1: only 3 of his 4 distinct attacks are told — 'spit' (main.js:8516, 8546) is chosen from the same pool as tongue/leap/inhale but fires with no windup mode, no '!' mark, and is not in windingUp() at all, so it lands with zero warning.

name: The Goblin Chieftain
a2: VIOLATION: bow's single-shot windup 'aim' is not in windingUp() — the (brute||chief) clause (main.js:18448) lists raise/wind/slashWind/bashWind/crouch/whirlWind/rainAim but not plain 'aim', so the single arrow (main.js:12289, 12321) gives no enemy-highlight/tell-SFX, only a floating '^' number glyph.
window: hittable at normal damage any time except during his 3 stances' active swings*; 2x bonus only while 'planted' (dmg*=2, main.js hurtGate)
a11why: 'planted' is reached two ways: automatically after every club 'raise→slam' and every 'whirl' finishes (timed, main.js:12302, 12310) — the common case — or, less often, by parrying his sword slash/club sweep (main.js:12304, 12316, both send him to 'planted' only 'if (res==="blocked")'). Since his club moveset (the default stance) routes to planted mainly on a timer, the waited path dominates even though a parry also works.
a10: At half HP he kicks over the brazier and lights two floor strips on fire (main.js:12333) — a permanent hazard added to the arena — while his own move speeds (walk, whirl, charge) all increase.
bugs: A2: bow single-shot 'aim' untelegraphed — see a2 above (matches the static scan's notInWindingUp:['aim']).

name: The Mother Cap
a2: ok — all her *Tell modes are covered by the generic (!e.harmless && mode.endsWith('Tell')) catch-all in windingUp() (main.js:18448); the explicit mother clause is redundant but consistent.
window: her body (t==='mother') is not the damageable entity at all — a separate 'heart' enemy is spawned (main.js:18335) and hurtEnemy0 returns with dmg=1 fixed unless mother.mode==='open' (main.js:5390): 'if (e.t==="heart"){ if(!mother||mother.mode!=="open") return; dmg=1; ... }'.
a11why: mother.mode is only ever set to 'open' by wakeMycelium() (main.js:18266-18271), which is called exclusively when the player's own hitbox strikes the glowbud prop (main.js:20006: 'wakeMycelium(pr)' inside the player-hit branch of the glowbud handler). The player must find and cut the moving root-anchor prop to force the heart open — textbook 'the player's action makes it happen'.
a10: Phase 2 (half HP) adds mycelium creep from both walls that poisons the floor, sporelings dropping from her gills, and layered pattern attacks (floor surge+volley, columns+rain); phase 3 (quarter HP) adds continuous seed rain and shortens her open-heart window from 8s to 5.5s, all concrete and readable.

name: The King
a2: ok — all his tell modes (slamTell/chargeTell/grabTell/cageTell/liftTell/shoutTell) are explicitly listed for t==='king' in windingUp() (main.js:18448).
window: IMMUNE by default — hurtEnemy0: 'if (e.t==="king" && e.mode!=="held" && !(e.open>0)) { ...clank...return; }' (deflects every blow); 2x bonus only while mode==='held'.
a11why: 'held' is only entered when the cage-drop mechanism (kingCage(), main.js:17063-17069) actually catches him under a dropcage prop, which the player must lure/trigger; releasing from 'held' grants a further 4s 'e.open' grace window (main.js:17005) — both routes to damage trace back to the cage the player worked to land, matching the design doc's own 'a cage brings his head down' example.
a10: Two real phase changes: at 2/3 HP (hurtEnemy0 ~5531) he rises off the litter and stands, gaining slam/grab/shout/cage/leap-free attacks and a 'held' state; at 2/5 HP ('THE KING RAGES') his grab reach (62→74), walk speed (44→62) and his court-summon cadence all increase and he goes for the throne throw.
bugs: Dead code, not a rule violation: main.js:17049 'if (false && e.phase===3 ...)' — a per-footstep rockfall/chandelier attack was fully written (stepT timer, rocks.push with lamp:true) and then wrapped in 'if(false&&...)', so it can never fire. Leftover, harmless, but worth a look if the design intent was for the phase-3 stride to shake debris loose.

name: The Great Hound ("Hound Master")
attacks: howl (howlTell→howl, summons pups — not a direct attack)
a2: ok — howlTell/lungeTell/pounceTell/snapTell all covered by the general (!e.harmless && mode.endsWith('Tell')) catch-all.
window: no hurtGate at all for t==='greathound' in hurtEnemy0 (static scan's hurtGate list is only the death-cleanup line) — always hittable at plain damage, no bonus/gated window anywhere.
a11why: there is no damage multiplier or immunity tied to any mode; the player can land a normal hit whenever they can reach him, including mid-attack recovery states (skid/landed/whine/stun).
a10: At half HP ('ENRAGED', hurtEnemy0 ~5536) he gains the close-range 'snap' bite (only available when p2) and his lunge/pounce speeds increase (270→300).
bugs: A1: only 3 attacks are told and land damage (lunge, pounce, snap); 'howl' is a summon, not a told attack, so it doesn't count toward the 4-minimum — he falls one short.

name: The Ram Lord
attacks: wall charge (lower→charge→crash, with a rear feint and phase-2 wall-banking)
call flock (callTell, summons goats — not a direct attack)
a2: ok — lower/stampTell/buttTell explicitly in windingUp()'s ram clause; leapTell/tossTell/callTell covered by the general Tell catch-all.
window: hittable at normal damage generally; 2x bonus via ramOpen(e) = mode==='crash' || mode==='land' (main.js:16712)
a11why: both bonus states are his own post-attack recovery: 'crash' fires automatically once his charge reaches the arena wall (main.js:16738, regardless of whether it hit you) and 'land' fires automatically once his leap's arc reaches the floor (main.js:16743) — neither requires a specific player action to trigger, only surviving/dodging the attack itself.
a10: At half HP ('ENRAGED') his charge speed jumps 220→290 and he gains wall-banking: up to twice per charge he angles off the wall instead of crashing dazed (main.js:16731-16737), removing the free 'crash' punish window the first two times and adding extra rockfalls.
bugs: none found (the old 'flock call had a case and nothing that ever chose it' issue noted in-comment at main.js:16718 appears already resolved — callTell is reachable via the e.n%5===2 branch).

name: The Owl Reeve
a2: ok — douseTell/fanTell/hootTell/screechTell/skimTell all covered by the general Tell catch-all; the explicit owl clause (fanTell/screechTell/hootTell) is redundant but consistent.
window: always hittable at 1x; no full-immunity gate for owl exists in hurtEnemy0. Bonus multipliers stack: 2x while 'crash'/'grounded', 2.5x while 'pinned', 2x while lampT>0 ('lamp-struck').
a11: mixed, caused-dominant on the bonus economy
a11why: the baseline 1x hit is always available (not caused), but every bonus window is deliberately made: 'pinned' only exists via the deadfall trap the player triggers (comment at main.js:13148 even calls it 'the only one the player MAKES rather than waits for'); 'crash'/lamp-struck require the player to have lit a specific lantern that her plunge/skim/swoop/hoot then crosses (main.js:13132, 13145, 13158, 13102); 'grounded' requires denying all 3 perches by lighting their lanterns (main.js:13113, 13164). The real reward structure of the fight is caused even though a base hit is not gated.
a10: Phase 2 (half HP) adds a new douseTell/douseDive attack that actively snuffs the player's own lit lanterns (removing their crash/lamp tools), plus faster skim cooldowns, a 2nd spawned spider on screech, and a wider feather fan (4→6).

name: The Weaver
a2: ok — dropTell/reelTell/spitTell all covered by the general Tell catch-all (the spider-specific clause only covers e.big && dropTell, but the catch-all covers the rest).
window: no hurtGate entries at all for t==='spider' in the static scan — always hittable at plain damage whenever in reach; her 'ground' state after a drop is simply when she is physically at melee height, not a coded damage bonus.
a11why: 'ground' (her practically-reachable state) is entered automatically at the bottom of every 'drop' attack (main.js:13029) — it is her own recovery beat after an attack lands or not, not something the player specifically causes.
a10: At half HP ('ENRAGED') she spawns two extra small spiders on every drop, and every speed/cooldown in her kit tightens (thread speed 62→96, ground scuttle 56→78, spit count 3→4, shorter tells).
bugs: A1: only 3 told attacks land damage (drop, spit, reel) — one short of the 4-attack minimum; matches the static scan's 3-tell list.

name: The Golem
attacks: shroud (shroudTell→shroud, raises rubble around itself — does not damage the player)
a2: ok — all four tells (shroudTell/stompTell/sweepTell/throwTell) are explicitly in windingUp()'s golem clause.
window: IMMUNE by default — hurtEnemy0 deflects ('SFX.clank()...') unless e.crackT>0 or mode==='stagger'; 1.5x bonus while 'stagger'.
a11why: crackT is set almost exclusively by ringing the tbell prop while the golem stands under it (main.js:17317-17319: 'const gd = enemies.find(...t==="golem"...); if (gd && Math.abs(gd.x-pr.x)<40) { gd.crackT=3.6; ... }', with an explicit 'IT IS NOT UNDER THE BELL' hint if it isn't positioned right) — the player must lure him under the bell and strike it. The only other damage source is the 'stagger' state after a facet breaks, which itself only happens after enough bell-caused hits land, so the whole damage economy traces back to the caused bell event.
a10: Each 25% HP lost breaks off a facet (stagger + 1.5x bonus window); the 2nd facet break (50% HP) sets phase=2, which shortens every attack cooldown (stomp/throw/shroud/sweep) and raises walk speed 30→44 — he gets meaningfully more aggressive.
bugs: A1: only 3 of his 4 told 'attacks' actually damage the player — 'shroud' (shroudTell→shroud) only raises ICE/rubble tiles around his own feet (main.js:14945-14946) and never calls damagePlayer, so it shouldn't count as a told attack; that leaves stomp/throw/sweep, one short of the minimum.

name: The False Abbot
attacks: chain/cast (castTell→cast — guarded pulls HIM via 'haul', taken reels the player in)
procession (processTell→process, a straight walk that hits on contact)
knell (knellTell→knell, phase 2 only — he rings the bell himself)
a2: ok — every abbot mode is TELL(what) = what+'Tell' by strict convention (false-abbot.js:51-52) and all six end in 'Tell', so they're all covered by windingUp()'s general (!e.harmless && mode.endsWith('Tell')) catch-all (main.js:18448); 'abbot' is never added to any harmless set.
window: warded almost continuously: abbotTake(e) (false-abbot.js:56-66) returns wardTake=0.2 while blessed, downMul=2 while downed, else 1x. He re-casts the 'rite' the instant blessT lapses (false-abbot.js:185: 'THE RITE IS HIS HEARTBEAT, not one move in ten'), so the ~1.5s riteTell windup is the only time he's at plain 1x; the downed state (2x, further stacked by the game's separate open-foe bonus to ~15x per the file's own worked example) is the real kill window.
a11why: 'downed' is only set by abbotBellRung() (false-abbot.js:91-98), which requires the player to strike the tbell prop while the abbot is within ABBOT.bellUnder (40px) of it — and he only gets near the bell because two of his own attacks are designed to move him there: a GUARDED chain snaps taut and hauls him a step toward the player (false-abbot.js:150-158), and the PROCESSION can be baited from the far side so he crosses under the bell himself (comment at false-abbot.js:17-21 explicitly: 'AND THE OPENING IS YOURS TO MAKE (tools/boss-openings.mjs proves it is CAUSED)'). A second, harder caused opening also exists: staggering him mid-'riteTell' spoils the rite before the ward lands (false-abbot.js:120-124, mode becomes 'spoiled').
a10: At half HP ('HE TAKES THE ROPE HIMSELF', false-abbot.js:107) he unlocks 'knell' — he rings the bell himself for damage and puts the room's one bell on a 7s cooldown, taking away the player's own opening tool for a while — the congregation spawn timer tightens (6.5s→4.2s) and his own attack cooldown shortens (1.5→1.15).
bugs: Checked per the other session's question: burn does NOT currently bypass his ward. The DOT tick (main.js:18581) calls 'wardedDamage(e, 2)', the same helper hurtEnemy0 uses for a direct hit (main.js:5285-5291, 5288 specifically routes t==='abbot' through abbotTake()), so a burning abbot still only takes a fifth while blessed and double while downed. This matches memory's '3 bugs fixed: burn bypassed every ward' — looks fixed in this checkout.

Checked per the other session's question: the lab bot's abbot branch does fire. lab.js:282's OPEN0 catch-all ('... : true') is only reached when BK.bossOpen(b) returns null/undefined (lab.js:281); main.js:24221's bossOpen() explicitly handles t==='abbot' (returns abbotOpen(e), a real boolean), so OPEN0's default-true never applies to him. Separately, lab.js:908-936 has a full dedicated abbot branch (wait by the bell, ring it when he's under it, guard the chain, dodge the procession, cut the congregation) that fires whenever he isn't already open/mid-drone-swarm/dash-target. The comments there date the 7/24 and 3/24 numbers to two OLDER, thinner versions of this branch (sword-only, then bell-only-no-chain-guard) that predate the current one — so 'the branch never fires' does not look true of the code as it stands now; those win rates are stale, not live.
